storia: Elon Musk at the DealBook Summit: 'not MAGA', regrets midterm spending, backs Skydance
ruolo: CEO of Tesla and SpaceX, owner of X
angoli_fatti: From 'dark MAGA' to 'quite moderate': Musk's DealBook confession, set against a $1B Skydance bet and a SpaceX permit that arrived the same week.
novita_oggi: At the NYT DealBook Summit Musk portrayed himself as a political moderate and regretted his midterm spending (NYT, CNBC); Variety reports David Ellison confirmed Musk invested in Skydance; Politico reports Texas issued an air permit for a SpaceX data center.
